name: Scottsdale Teen Employment Program (STEP)
org: City of Scottsdale, Vista Career Center
what_you_do: Get one-on-one job help from a teen employment specialist. They help with your resume, practice interviews, and job search. They give job referrals when they can.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 19 who live in the Scottsdale area.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page. This program helps you find a job. It is not a job itself.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline. Make an appointment any time. The fall and spring job skills events are postponed.
how_to_apply: Call 480-312-0060 or email VistaCareerCenter@ScottsdaleAZ.gov to make an appointment. You can meet online or in person.
notes: The career center is at 7700 E. Roosevelt St., Scottsdale. It has a self-serve computer lab for job searches. The center is open Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm. Specialists are available 8 am to 4 pm.
